verdict.rationale: Google's public plans page (one.google.com/about/plans) lists per-plan storage quotas, such as 100 GB and 2 TB shared across Photos, Drive and Gmail, and shows that storage can be shared with up to 5 others. The evidence pack does not show the prices on that page, and the only pricing figure is an old community comment. missing for 10: published per-plan/per-user prices in first-party evidence, documentation of what happens when the storage cap is reached, Workspace per-user plan pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
